title: NaviShell plugin registry index
description: The marketplace list NaviShell downloads with the `plugins_fetch_registry` command (Settings > Plugins > Marketplace). The app drops any entry that does not satisfy this schema instead of failing the whole index, so a malformed entry is simply never offered for install.

$schema.description: Path or URL of this schema, for editor completion only; the app ignores it.

name.description: Display name of the index itself, shown above the list.

updatedAt.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the last change to this file.

plugins.description: The listed plugins. Ids must be unique; duplicates are not rejected by the app, they just both show up.

localizedText.description: Either one string, or an object keyed by UI locale. The app falls back to `en` and then to the first value.

id.description: The plugin id, identical to `id` in its `plugin.json`. Lowercase letters, digits, '.', '_' and '-' only, starting with a letter or digit. The `navishell.` prefix is reserved for built-in plugins. Convention: `<vendor>.<plugin>`.

name.description: Display name shown in the marketplace list.

description.description: One sentence on what the plugin does.

version.description: Version of the plugin the `url` points at, identical to `version` in its `plugin.json`.

url.description: Direct http(s) download URL of the plugin zip (a GitHub Release asset, not a web page). Pin it to a tag, never to a moving branch.

sha256.description: Hex SHA-256 of the zip at `url`. Strongly recommended: the app verifies it before unpacking and refuses a download that does not match.

homepage.description: Repository or documentation page of the plugin.

minHostVersion.description: Lowest NaviShell version the plugin works with, e.g. "0.2.0".

icon.description: A lucide-react icon name in PascalCase, e.g. "Puzzle".
